task_description: Add batch frame generation and T4 GPU memory management to ltx23_director_mv_30s.py. The script currently tries to generate all 756 frames in a single pass causing OOM on T4 (16GB VRAM). Changes: batch_frames parameter, skip_pass2 option, lower default resolution, enhanced PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF, more aggressive memory cleanup, updated comments.
